title: Haunted Mansion Dungeon
subtitle: Frest Greelving's three belongings, Dark Sarcophagus at the bottom
steps: In the Facility Hub, ask the Warden about the Haunted Mansion (level 30+).
Recover Frest Greelving's three belongings: an Ornate Nekode, a Silver Atlatl and a Tetsubo Slugger.
Show them to the Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Item source
notes.body: The data does not place the three belongings. They probably drop from the Dark Sarcophagus or sit in the locked Storage chests near the entrance. Inferred, not read.

notes.title: Dark Sarcophagus
notes.body: Level 666 with 0.0 resistance to slash, pierce, bludgeon, cold, acid and electric, 0.5 fire. Treat it as an object to open, not a fight.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Liches (level 20) and Revenants take cold best (0.2), then pierce (0.52). Skeleton Captains and Wraiths take bludgeon at 1.0 and cold at 0.3-0.4, but resist pierce.

notes.title: Locked chests
notes.body: Five Storage chests sit in the first room off the entrance and are locked.
